citation: van Houten et al. 1997, modal damping of bells
measurement_method: Material and acoustic damping components; the paper's Q = 1/(2*eta)
note: REFERENCE ONLY. Extremely lightly damped: Q ~ 1600. Note the convention: this paper's eta is a damping ratio, while Ege 2018 reports a loss factor (Q = 1/eta). Each is converted by its own paper's relation.

rows.provenance: material damping 0.0002 + acoustic damping 0.0001 = total 0.0003; the paper's own relation Q = 1/(2*eta) gives Q = 1667, matching its stated ~1600. No modal frequency is stated, so no bandwidth is derived
